item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame

turns.text: Can you make this fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text.

item.tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.
answer_sheet.Filling extra space: A blurred copy of the same photo behind the intact portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

must_haves: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

turns.text: can you make a pic from this pic

dialog.agent:
Yes, I can do that. What kind of picture do you want? Some options:

1. **New look or style:** turn the photo into anime, a watercolor painting, a Pixar-style character, a sketch and so on.
2. **New background or scene:** put her on a beach, in a city at night, in a cozy café, in a studio and so on.
3. **Professional headshot:** a polished, LinkedIn-style portrait.
4. **Outfit change:** swap the gray sweater for a blazer, a dress or any other outfit you describe.
5. **Other edits:** add accessories, change the hair or season, remove the background and so on.

Tell me which one you want, plus any details like style, setting or mood. Your account is on the free plan, so the result will be a single 640px image.
dialog.why: It offers several edit options and asks the user to pick one and give details before it goes ahead.
dialog.user: none of those really, i just want it to fit an instagram story. keep all my hair and shoulders in it, no text

turns.agent:
I couldn't make it. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned the request down. Nothing was created and no credits were used.

I'd already used the cheapest free-plan model (flux-2-klein at 640px, one image), so no other setting would get around this. I didn't change your request to make it fit.

**What I would have made:** a vertical 9:16 Instagram Story version of your photo. The park background would be extended above and below you so your hair and shoulders stay in frame, with no text.

**To get it:**
- **Add credits:** buy a credit pack or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me and I'll run the same request.
- **Do it in Instagram for free:** add the photo to a Story and pinch to shrink it until your hair and shoulders fit. Instagram fills the space above and below with colors from the photo. This won't extend the park scene, but it costs nothing.
